milestones.deliverable: Freeze official base, references, contracts and reproducible evidence
Theme tokens, appearance and usable shell
Dedicated bounded transport and virtual-time feasibility
Clock, reset, IRQ, GDMA and GPIO endpoints
Minimum crypto, RNG, key/eFuse and persistent NVS/calibration/bond prerequisites
Radio clock, power, sleep/wakeup and retention prerequisites
Real digital nets and durable circuit document
Analog DC/RC and native ADC acquisition
Native UART, I2C and SPI bidirectional devices
Clocked RMT, I2S, LCD and camera streams
Required release matrix, soak and packaging

acceptance.positive: boot_smoke plus new stable-IDF/Arduino/OTA/PSRAM fixtures
acceptance.negative: Invalid/app-only image, corrupt partition and unsupported profile rejected
acceptance.reset: Cold, software, watchdog and interrupted OTA reboot
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: ROM/flash specification and real board boot/persistence records

acceptance.positive: Dual-core exceptions, atomics, MMU/cache, FPU and actual register snapshots
acceptance.negative: Illegal instruction, access fault, stale/unavailable debug data
acceptance.reset: Core-specific reset and per-core state isolation
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Pinned ISA/TRM and board raw state

acceptance.positive: Gating/divider changes and shared-source IRQ aggregation
acceptance.negative: Invalid routing and asserted IRQ remap without lost source
acceptance.reset: Peripheral/core/watchdog reset and sleep retention
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM domains and hardware edge/IRQ captures

acceptance.positive: Partial bursts, descriptor chains, simultaneous channels and circular stream
acceptance.negative: Bad owner/length/address/cycle, backpressure and PSRAM constraints
acceptance.reset: Stop/restart/reset mid-descriptor discards old work
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM descriptor state and hardware buffer/IRQ results

acceptance.positive: Native button/LED, matrix fanout/inversion, open-drain and branched nets
acceptance.negative: Disconnected/reserved/float/contention/no-pullup and address/CS conflict
acceptance.reset: Hold/sleep/reset defaults and topology-generation apply
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: S3 pad/TRM/board profile plus logic-analyzer capture

acceptance.positive: Divider/pot/source impedance/RC step and voltage-derived digital edges
acceptance.negative: Singular/floating node, conflicting sources and convergence failure
acceptance.reset: Source/topology reset and explicit capacitor initial state
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Analytic circuits, independent numerical reference and measured board voltage

acceptance.positive: Oneshot, ADC1 continuous pattern/filter/monitor and eFuse calibration
acceptance.negative: Clipping, missing calibration, overflow, ADC2 DMA erratum/arbitration
acceptance.reset: Conversion/DMA/reset and radio enable/disable interactions
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Errata/TRM and measured voltage/source-impedance sweep

acceptance.positive: External full-duplex bytes, FIFO/IRQ and flow control via routed pads
acceptance.negative: Wrong baud/parity/framing, break, overrun and RTS/CTS stall
acceptance.reset: Reset during TX/RX, restart and console/protocol isolation
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Driver/TRM and peer waveform/byte capture

acceptance.positive: Stateful slave verifies real repeated START and >FIFO TX/RX
acceptance.negative: Address/data NACK, collision, stretching timeout and stuck SDA
acceptance.reset: Abort/reset/recovery at each command phase
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Driver/TRM plus hardware slave that distinguishes STOP from repeated START

acceptance.positive: Actual MISO, phases/modes/order/CS, PIO/DMA flash readback and panel
acceptance.negative: Wrong/disconnected CS/MISO, malformed DMA, underrun and conflicting drivers
acceptance.reset: Reset/abort while CS active or descriptor incomplete
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM/device datasheets and full-duplex hardware captures

acceptance.positive: Pulse durations, filtering/carrier/loop/DMA and WS2812/IR fixture
acceptance.negative: RX overflow, empty TX, timeout and routing contention
acceptance.reset: Disable/reset during waveform and DMA wrap
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM, timestamped independent pulse captures

acceptance.positive: Exact sample packing/frame clocks and continuous TX/RX DMA
acceptance.negative: Underrun/overrun, unsupported mode, wrong external clock
acceptance.reset: Stop/restart/rate change and descriptor-wrap reset
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: S3 capability table/TRM plus independent PCM/clock reference

acceptance.positive: Known frame checksum, control pins, sync/pclk and buffer ownership
acceptance.negative: Starved/wrong-size buffer, bad sync/control, circular chain bounded
acceptance.reset: Panel/guest reset, VSYNC buffer swap and PSRAM profile
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Native driver/device specs and real frame/signal captures

acceptance.positive: Normal camera driver reads deterministic sensor frames and DMA EOF
acceptance.negative: Truncated/oversized frame, missing sync, FIFO/DMA overflow
acceptance.reset: Reset sensor/camera during frame and bounded stop/restart
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Sensor/TRM plus independent chart bytes and timing capture

acceptance.positive: Unchanged blob init followed by scan/security/AP/STA and real IP payload
acceptance.negative: Auth/association/key replay/DHCP/backend loss and queue starvation
acceptance.reset: Cold/warm calibration, reconnect, reset/stop/start and coexistence
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Pinned vendor libraries/TRM plus AP/peer packet captures

acceptance.positive: Unchanged controller and NimBLE/Bluedroid; roles/GATT/security/peers
acceptance.negative: Rejected pairing, permission/credit/fragment faults and timeout
acceptance.reset: Bond restore/unbond/reset/connect-disconnect and coexistence
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Controller feature masks/specs plus independent BLE peer/captures

acceptance.positive: Every catalogued operation has byte-exact state/alias/operand vectors
acceptance.negative: Saturation/shift edges, illegal encoding and memory fault side effects
acceptance.reset: Per-core/reset/interrupt/task context save and restore
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Independent fixed-width reference and COM5 board vectors

acceptance.positive: Duty/fade/deadtime/capture/sync/fault output and IRQ behavior
acceptance.negative: Illegal config, fault/brake and missed-update cases
acceptance.reset: Clock gate/reset and duty update mid-period
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM and hardware pulse/capture reference

acceptance.positive: External edge/direction/filter/watch/limit behavior
acceptance.negative: Glitch pulses, overflow and missing control pin
acceptance.reset: Clear/reset and pulse routing changes while counting
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM plus pulse-source and board count records

acceptance.positive: Native loopback/peer arbitration/filter and frames
acceptance.negative: ACK/error/bus-off/malformed frame/recovery
acceptance.reset: Controller reset during arbitration and bus-off recovery
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Controller specification and independent CAN peer trace

acceptance.positive: Native enumeration and endpoint/FIFO/IRQ transfer profiles
acceptance.negative: Bad descriptor, stall/disconnect and transfer overflow
acceptance.reset: Bus/controller reset and endpoint teardown
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: USB specs/TRM and independent host/device capture

acceptance.positive: Native commands/card model/data/DMA and filesystem read/write
acceptance.negative: No card, CRC/error response, bad descriptor and removal
acceptance.reset: Reset/removal mid-command/data and persistence recovery
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM/card specification and hardware image/command capture

acceptance.positive: Explicit capacitance/threshold/filter/wakeup and native touch driver
acceptance.negative: Disconnected/floating/noisy input and threshold corner cases
acceptance.reset: Sleep/hold/reset and wakeup retention
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: TRM plus characterized capacitance/hardware readings

acceptance.positive: Native ULP examples execute and wake main CPU using RTC memory
acceptance.negative: Invalid program/config, unavailable power domain and bounds
acceptance.reset: Deep sleep/wakeup/reset retention of coprocessor/RTC state
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: ULP ISA/TRM and board wakeup/state results

requirements.title: crypto, eFuse, RNG and secure boot

acceptance.positive: Official crypto vectors, permissions and consistent eFuse/flash profiles
acceptance.negative: Invalid key purpose, protected read/write, signature or cipher rejection
acceptance.reset: Crypto busy reset, flash/eFuse persistence and seeded replay mode
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Known-answer vectors and revision-specific official security behavior

acceptance.positive: First boot, wire sensor/analog source, save/reopen, switch themes, keyboard route
acceptance.negative: Invalid project/artifact/QMP timeout/model crash and actionable recovery
acceptance.reset: Session/device restart and restored document/view without stale evidence
acceptance.compatibility: Required current stable plus applicable supported release/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Carbon/Qt sources plus visual and assistive-tool workflow review

acceptance.positive: Native sensor enable/range/clock/read/calibration profile
acceptance.negative: Out-of-range profile, unavailable readiness and calibration errors
acceptance.reset: Sensor clock/domain reset and disabled acquisition
acceptance.compatibility: Applicable supported IDF/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: S3 driver/TRM plus board temperature/code profile

acceptance.positive: Native prescale/duty/routed waveform and RC voltage effects
acceptance.negative: Bad profile, disconnected pad and disabled output
acceptance.reset: Disable/reset mid-waveform and pad rerouting
acceptance.compatibility: Applicable supported IDF/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: Pinned SoC capabilities and board waveform/reference RC voltage

acceptance.positive: Profiled VDD sweep triggers detection/reset reason and retention
acceptance.negative: Undefined threshold band, filter/power state and conflicting rails
acceptance.reset: Repeated rail drop/recovery with reset-domain retention
acceptance.compatibility: Applicable supported IDF/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: S3 brownout specification and measured rail/reset capture

requirements.title: APB backup and RTC retention DMA

acceptance.positive: Native low-power register save/restore and transfer descriptor behavior
acceptance.negative: Corrupt/missing retained data, bad descriptor and overflow
acceptance.reset: Reset/abort/sleep/wakeup preserves only declared domains
acceptance.compatibility: Applicable supported IDF/Arduino/chip-profile matrix; exact hashes and skips recorded.
acceptance.reference: S3 retention engine specification and board low-power state results

cross_cutting.acceptance: COM5 inventory and identity before capture; reviewable unchanged hardware/QEMU fixtures; exact output/hash/uncertainty records; no unapproved flashing
Pinned supported recent IDF and Arduino stable lanes plus forward/older compatibility profiles; mandatory fixtures cannot silently skip
Framing/epoch/limits/backpressure/host barrier watchdog; deterministic guest results under varied host latency/reset/crash
Session/epoch/virtual-time/sequence data, bounded recording, replay feasibility and explicit loss; no UI redraw changes simulation
Pinned official base and patches; native-driver and independent reference evidence; unverified or unsupported profiles remain explicit
